title: Several states over the course of a day
description: The time and the circumstances are kept alongside a person’s own check-ins.

blocks.text: The author of the review below values being able to discuss entries at a meeting with a professional. More detailed check-ins within a day may help reconstruct the experience, but this quote on its own does not prove the value of any particular measurement frequency.

quote.text: I share the report with my psychiatrist before and during every visit and it’s really helpful!

blocks.text: Keep the episodes the person chooses
Allow several check-ins with a time and an optional note. Let the overview lead back to individual episodes; for a conversation, let the entries be picked and the selection previewed.
Do not explain on the person’s behalf

Time, mood and circumstances help recall an event. Their coinciding does not establish the cause of a state; a person’s own note has to stay distinguishable from an automatically suggested explanation.
